title: feat(console): keep list column widths, row height and tab order in this browser only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVWbxPZ72M6BDYup19WL5XS)_

Part of #35955

## What changes

On a Console object list, the column widths, the row height and the order of the view tabs are now kept in the reader's browser only. The Console no longer reads or writes the per-user list preference row `sys_user_preference` `ui.list.<object>`.

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/listLayoutStore.ts`: one localStorage entry per signed-in reader and object, `list-layout:<user id>:<object>`, holding `viewOrder` and per view `widths` / `rowHeight` and nothing else. With nobody signed in there is no key: nothing is read or written. Built on `useSyncExternalStore`, so every reader of the same object sees a write at once.
- The keys an earlier Console wrote list state under (`list-state:*`, the cache of the retired server row; `list-filters:*`; the bare `viewOrder:*`) are removed once per page load and never read. What they held is not carried over.
- `ListPreferencesProvider` is deleted; `ConsoleShell` no longer creates or attaches the `ui.list.` family, and `UserStateAdapters` drops its list-state slot. The boot read of the reader's preferences now asks for the four keys and the `ui.record.` prefix only.
- The list no longer waits for a preference read before it mounts (the `object-view-list-preferences-pending` placeholder is gone).
- `listFilterStorage.ts` is deleted: `writeListFilterState` had no caller (F4 of the card).
- The relay-shape types the list draft uses (`ListViewPreference` and friends) move into `listDraftStore.ts`.
- `RecordPreferencesProvider` (`ui.record.*`) is untouched.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` says the layout stays in this browser. The platform checklist items `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` (rev 14) and `records-forms.grid-personalization` (rev 10) are re-pointed; the latter now reads that widths and row height do not follow the reader to a fresh browser (Sales ruling D1 on #35955).
- Comment and README fixes in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/react` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` that named the retired key.

Not in this pull request:

- `os migrate list-preferences`, the operator command that deletes the stored `ui.list.*` rows (dry run by default, `--apply` only with an owner-only `--export`). This PR was over 3,000 changed lines with it, so it follows in its own pull request once this one merges. Until then the rows stay, unread.
- Keeping `list-layout:` entries across a sign-out by the same person: follow-up #36110. Sign-out still clears them, as today.
- Related-tab column widths (`ui.record.<object>.relatedLists`): #35892.
- The spec `columnState` retirement.

## Why

Card #35955 (epic #35547): a list change is a draft, and what never becomes a draft (widths, row height, tab order) is arranging only, so it stays in the reader's browser and never reaches another user, device or browser.

## Verification

- The 13 changed or rewritten test files pass: 177 tests (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run …`). They include `listLayoutStore.slot-35955.test.tsx` (sanitize, patch, localStorage-only writes with no request, cross-instance sync, entry removal, no entry while signed out, retired-key sweep), `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx` (40 cases on the real page, writes recorded at the storage door), `signOutPurge.test.tsx` and `consoleUserPreferenceBudget.test.tsx` (one read, no `ui.list.` prefix, no `ui.list.*` write).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) passes.
- ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: OK.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite runs in CI (Test UI).

Tests rewritten because the provider they drove is gone:

- `ListPreferencesProvider.slot-12418.test.ts` → `views/listLayoutStore.slot-35955.test.tsx`.
- `ObjectView.userListState-12418`: the provider and family harness is replaced by a seeded localStorage entry. "Waits for the read" cases are gone. The 500 ms debounce case is replaced by "re-stating a width just written sends no second write". The provider-less CONTROL block now pins the retired-key sweep.
- `ObjectView.personalViews-29635` (#30034): the default view's state is a held draft, so the second read is gone. The "reverse order" case becomes "the personal views read landing at once".
- `signOutPurge`: the server-save-before-sign-out case is gone, since there is no server save. The sign-out sweep cases now cover `list-layout:*`.
- `consoleUserPreferenceBudget`, `ObjectView.listPersonalized-28950`, `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860`, `ObjectView.ufViewSwitch-11992`, `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694`, `objectViewViewCrud.draftBarChange-35932` and `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly`: the harness or source pin is updated.

Overlap: merges cleanly with `main`. It textually overlaps #36123 (PR2 of the same card) and #36128. Whichever of PR2 and this one lands later merges `main`.
